finding_summary: 13 ALL-FIGURE-KIND-KNOWN S3 findings because the candidate record uses ORBITAL_MODEL while the pinned Chemistry vocabulary contains ORBITAL_DIAGRAM.
3 BP-COMPONENTS-EXPECTED S3 findings because EQUATIONS is absent from the three Core1A construction units; equations are not needed to establish the targeted qualitative orbital/model bridges.

observed_nonblocking_ui_findings: The focus probe reported 10 failures among 105 candidates in the audited profiles.
Landscape profiles reported sticky-header anchor-safety risk for deep-linked unit anchors; portrait had no sticky-header anchor risk.

evidence.H: Hints move from prediction of a permanent localized model to bond-equivalence evidence, then preserve the D3 bridge by separating pi-model choice from local sp2 assignment.
evidence.S: The staged contributor/invariant/p-orbital representation exposes source drawings and invariant sigma structure before the final delocalised overlay.
evidence.P: Attempt gating and protected-search checks passed; the solution route gives explicit why-valid warrants and an independent equivalence check.
evidence.M: The wrong route, diagnostic comparison and replacement rule explicitly distinguish contributor literalism/circular hybridisation reasoning from the intended model.

evidence.H: Hints explicitly ask what is invariant, separate sigma from pi, require a compatible p direction, and warn against time-switching language without giving the full bridge at the start.
evidence.S: The four-stage visual maps contributors to invariant sigma skeleton to perpendicular p set to one delocalised pi overlay.
evidence.P: The frozen page keeps protected content gated; post-attempt reasoning preserves connectivity/charge/sigma invariants and checks translation back to equivalent N-O positions.
evidence.M: The diagnostic targets the specific misconception that nitrate cycles among drawings and repairs it with contributor-versus-electronic-structure language.

evidence.H: Hints force atom-local counting before p-orbital inventory and leave the geometry bridge to the learner.
evidence.S: The staged allene SVG moves from local sigma frameworks through each orthogonal pi overlap to the terminal-plane consequence.
evidence.P: The route explains why central sp leaves two orthogonal p orbitals and checks the ~90-degree terminal-plane projection in the introductory model.
evidence.M: The wrong ethene-like planar copy is explicitly diagnosed and repaired by assigning one orthogonal central p orbital to each pi bond.

evidence.H: Hints compare the number and orientation of unhybridised p orbitals rather than invoking memorised geometry.
evidence.S: The allene stages support the causal comparison with ethene while preserving the D3 bridge until the later stage.
evidence.P: Post-attempt reasoning connects local sp2/sp models to side-on overlap constraints and checks that one planar p axis cannot support both allene pi bonds.
evidence.M: The molecule-wide 'sp2 means planar' misconception is named, diagnosed by orbital counting, and replaced with an atom-local plus orbital-consistency rule.

evidence.H: Hints use CO2 and NH3 as counterexamples before giving the replacement criterion.
evidence.S: The local-decision visual makes the atom-by-atom count/assign/check procedure visible without using bond equivalence as the criterion.
evidence.P: The answer explicitly separates equivalence, local electron-domain count and hybridisation model status; the counterexample check classifies CO2/NH3/nitrate consistently.
evidence.M: The overgeneralised 'equivalent bonds imply sp2' rule is directly diagnosed and replaced with local sigma/electron-domain reasoning.

evidence.H: The three hints distinguish atom-local domain counting from global sigma/pi bond-component counting without over-scaffolding the D2 execution.
evidence.S: The local procedure visual supports one-centre-at-a-time counting and the leftover-p-orbital check.
evidence.P: The route correctly returns CH3 carbon sp3, both alkyne carbons sp, 6 sigma and 2 pi, with an independent component count.
evidence.M: The triple-bond-as-three-domains/three-sigma misconception is diagnosed by separately asking for neighbour directions and bond components, then repaired with one-sigma-plus-two-pi decomposition.

evidence.H: Hints identify the common carbonate skeleton, contributor-local bookkeeping and compatible p direction before the learner formulates the one model.
evidence.S: The contributor/invariant/delocalisation stages are transferable from nitrate to carbonate without asserting quantitative bond order.
evidence.P: The answer uses a planar sp2 sigma framework plus qualitative delocalised pi system and explicitly rejects a single contributor/time-switching story.
evidence.M: The 'real contributor' or 'hopping double bond' route is explicitly detected and repaired by the formal-contributor plus delocalised-model distinction.

evidence.H: Hints make the sigma-axis versus parallel-p requirement explicit but leave the comparison and no-energy-number conclusion to the learner.
evidence.S: The pi-overlap continuity representation distinguishes end-on sigma alignment from side-on p overlap and its orientation sensitivity.
evidence.P: The answer appropriately says ethane sigma overlap remains aligned under axial rotation while conformational interactions may vary, and refuses to infer a numerical barrier from the sketch.
evidence.M: It directly diagnoses the two common overclaims: exactly zero ethane cost and ethene twisting requiring sigma-bond rupture; the repair separates overlap geometry from energetics.

evidence.H: Hints ask the learner to mark participating atoms and walk the p-orbital chain, preserving the representation decision.
evidence.S: The continuity visual contrasts adjacent aligned p centres with an sp3 bridge lacking an unhybridised p orbital.
evidence.P: The answer correctly identifies four adjacent sp2 centres in butadiene and the central sp3 CH2 interruption in 1,4-pentadiene; the substitution check restores continuity when the bridge becomes sp2.
evidence.M: The 'any two double bonds are one delocalised system' misconception is detected by asking for an uninterrupted p orbital on every intervening atom and repaired with the continuous-pathway rule.

evidence.H: Hints first make the one-label heuristic fail on propyne/allene, then require the learner to construct the atom-local replacement and orbital check.
evidence.S: The local decision stages encode choose atom -> count domains -> assign local model -> verify leftover p orbitals, matching the required procedure without molecule-wide labelling.
evidence.P: The answer returns propyne sp3/sp/sp and allene sp2/sp/sp2 and checks that the required number/orientation of p orbitals remain.
evidence.M: The conspicuous-multiple-bond/overall-shape heuristic is explicitly diagnosed and replaced with atom-local sigma-domain counting plus p-orbital consistency.

limitations: This is an execution-agent semantic review of its own frozen candidate, not independent release certification.
The simulated learner preset is not measured mastery.
The benchmark observations are supplied givens, not new experimental measurements.
The 16 S3 quality-gate findings and browser focus/anchor observations remain explicit handoff findings rather than being hidden by the PASS verdict.
